claim_text: Real GDP Growth Rate of 9.2% for 2023-24 (highest in the previous 12 years except 2021-22)
Provisional Estimates: Real GDP estimated to grow by 6.5% in FY 2024-25

India’s GDP grows 8.2% in FY24 against 7% in FY23 ("India’s real GDP is estimated to grow by 8.2 percent in the Financial Year 2023-24 as compared to the growth rate of 7 percent registered in Financial Year 2022-23.")
MoSPI data also highlighted that India’s real GDP grew by 9.2 percent in the financial year 2023-24, the highest annual growth in 12 years, excluding the post-pandemic rebound in FY22.
